theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (D F : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (ν : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)) (y v : Euclid (m + 1)) (ρ₁ C₁ : ℝ), MeasurableSet F → Measurable ν → (∀ z, ‖ν z‖ = 1) → (∀ φ : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ z in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ φ z : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) = -∫ z, inner ℝ (φ z) (ν z) ∂μ) → ‖v‖ = 1 → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (μ (closedBall y ρ)).toReal⁻¹ • ∫ z in closedBall y ρ, ν z ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 v) → 0 < ρ₁ → 0 ≤ C₁ → closedBall y ρ₁ ⊆ D → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₁ → μ (closedBall y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C₁ * ρ ^ m)) → ∀ ζ : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∀ w : Euclid (m + 1), inner ℝ w v = 0 → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ z in (fun z => y + r • z) ⁻¹' F, fderiv ℝ ζ z w) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
